ci_method: 95% t interval across paired seed means; scenario families averaged within seed
independent_unit: seed, not decision, agent, or family
risk_definition: incorrect reserves / all reserves (zero if no reserves; inspect coverage)
regret_definition: reserve while available=2, defer while disrupted=6, verify=1.5; otherwise 0
correction_definition: local direct contradictory observation to next agreeing decision; non-recovery reported separately

config.capacity_semantics: FIFO experiences per agent, including episodic records; 0 means unlimited
config.fairness: same local input schema and cap, original architecture lookup rules; structured exact-key versus retrieval top-4 is disclosed
config.eligibility: scheduled decisions only when own inventory is below next delivery need; policy can change future opportunity count
config.freeze: development0:9; heldout1000:1029; thresholds1,2,3 predeclared; no heldout selection
